packs.label: Core Physiology Traits
packs.description: High-utility baseline physiology traits covering histamine, lactose, caffeine, alcohol, methylation, iron, vitamin D, B12, thyroid conversion, antioxidant handling, and general metabolic sensitivity.

packs.label: Pharmacogenomics (PGx)
packs.description: Medication metabolism, transport, toxicity, HLA hypersensitivity, and clinical PGx guardrails. Requires clinician/pharmacist interpretation before action.

packs.label: Metabolic Health & T2D
packs.description: Glucose regulation, insulin secretion/resistance, appetite/adiposity, triglycerides, fatty liver, uric acid, and metabolic pharmacogenomic context.

packs.label: Nutrients & One-Carbon Methylation
packs.description: Folate, B12, choline, vitamin D, iron, fatty acids, antioxidant enzymes, minerals, and nutrient transport/metabolism guardrails.

packs.label: Neurotransmitter & Mood Resiliency
packs.description: Dopamine, serotonin, norepinephrine, HPA-axis stress biology, neuroplasticity, reward, social-stress, and psychiatric genetics guardrails.

packs.label: Sleep & Circadian Rhythms
packs.description: Circadian timing, sleep pressure, insomnia/hypersomnia context, parasomnias, sleep apnea, dream-related evidence gaps, and clinical sleep-testing guardrails.

packs.label: Connective Tissue & Musculoskeletal Integrity
packs.description: Collagen, cartilage, tendons, ligaments, bone-density, hypermobility, EDS/Marfan/aortopathy guardrails, and injury-susceptibility context.

packs.label: Thyroid Hormone & Autoimmune Risk
packs.description: Thyroid hormone conversion/function, Hashimoto/Graves autoimmune susceptibility, selenium/iodine/thyroid synthesis guardrails, and PMDD-thyroid hormone-sensitivity overlay context.

packs.label: Cardiovascular & Lipid Transport
packs.description: Apolipoproteins, LDL/ApoB/Lp(a), blood pressure, thrombosis, arrhythmia, cardiomyopathy/aortopathy guardrails, and cardiovascular PGx context.

packs.label: High-Stakes Cancer Predisposition
packs.description: Cancer predisposition genes, selected founder variants, PRS/guardrails, and confirmation-only hereditary cancer interpretation.

packs.label: Allergy, Atopy & Mast-Cell Context
packs.description: Allergic rhinitis, eczema, asthma-atopy overlap, IgE tendency, food-allergy context, urticaria/angioedema red flags, and mast-cell guardrails.

packs.label: Digestive, Gut & Microbiome Context
packs.description: Lactose, celiac permissiveness, IBD loci, bile/gallbladder, liver-gut, host glycan/microbiome context, and food intolerance guardrails.

packs.label: Muscle Performance, Hypertrophy & Recovery
packs.description: Power/endurance bias, hypertrophy/recovery context, creatine/lactate/mitochondrial biology, tendon injury overlap, and myopathy red-flag guardrails.

packs.label: Menstrual Cycle, Menopause, Hormones & Reproductive Context
packs.description: Menstrual-phase and menopause-transition context, estrogen/progesterone/androgen signaling, PMDD symptom-timing and steroid-sensitivity context, contraceptive composition guardrails, adenomyosis/endometriosis workup limits, steroid metabolism, and fertility guardrails.

packs.label: Skin, Hair & Dermatology Context
packs.description: Pigmentation, UV sensitivity, eczema/psoriasis/acne context, scarring, collagen skin matrix, androgenic hair loss, and melanoma guardrails.

packs.label: Bone Growth, Mineral Density & Skeletal Development
packs.description: Bone mineral density, fracture context, vitamin D/calcium/PTH pathways, Wnt signaling, rare bone disorder guardrails, and DXA/lab overlays.

packs.label: Kidney, Fluid Balance & Electrolytes
packs.description: Uric acid/gout, kidney stone context, salt sensitivity, renal drug transport, eGFR loci, and electrolyte/renal red-flag guardrails.

packs.label: Respiratory, Airway & Oxygenation Context
packs.description: Asthma/allergic airway loci, lung function/COPD context, alpha-1 antitrypsin, sleep-apnea airway overlay, and spirometry/sleep-study guardrails.

packs.label: Immune & Autoimmune General Susceptibility
packs.description: General autoimmune loci, HLA callability rules, celiac/T1D/RA/MS/psoriasis/IBD context, and autoantibody/lab guardrails.

packs.label: Pain, Migraine & Sensory Processing
packs.description: Migraine loci, pain sensitivity, opioid/endocannabinoid context, taste/sensory traits, and channelopathy red-flag guardrails.

packs.label: Dental, Oral Health & Taste Context
packs.description: Caries/enamel, periodontal inflammation, oral microbiome/mucosal context, bitter/sweet taste, tooth-development guardrails, and bruxism evidence-gap rules.

packs.label: Longevity, Aging Resilience & Healthspan Context
packs.description: Aging-resilience context across APOE/FOXO3/telomeres/inflammation/oxidative stress/metabolic health, with no-lifespan-prediction guardrails.

packs.label: Research Found (Vector Discoveries)
packs.description: Auto-grown from vector research drafts. Hypothesis-grade candidates only — review alleles and evidence before treating as curated. Never merges into other packs.
